review: #3871 should adopt the same two-lineage verdict split already proved in #3880: exit-code/command disagreement is hard semantic divergence; log-digest disagreement is separately visible evidence divergence. Treating timing-bearing pytest logs as a single hard boolean would make honest clean-room replays unusable.
The clean-room receipt from #3871 should remain donor-side evidence. #3880 project-side verification is a second independent observer; neither receipt should overwrite or collapse the other.

#3872 should gate submission on the exact result-bundle digest plus the exact clean-room verification receipt digest, then persist pacing against the resulting PR identity. Network/auth uncertainty while refreshing pacing must not be interpreted as 'PR closed'.

The proposed DCO line in a PR body may not satisfy repositories whose DCO bot checks commit trailers. Submission should verify commit Signed-off-by trailers (or create signed-off commits) in addition to rendering any PR-body sign-off text.
Draft-by-default is the safer #3872 decision and matches the volunteer program's authority boundary: preparation/submission does not imply maintainer acceptance.
recommended_order: wire #3872 to consume that exact verification receipt
keep #3880 as independent project-side MVP observer rather than a PoC submission dependency
